integrity: Exact rational standalone verifier included. Proof for all population sizes is given separately from finite checks. No independent external validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete fixed uniform hypergraph; all-group discrete event sampling; every selected member copies a single uniformly chosen speaker; no active-only Poisson clock, no rewiring, and no single-node-only update. A three-holdout example disproves extension of the simple one-rate law in general. Priority relative to unindexed equivalent literature remains uncertain.
title: A one-rate consensus clock with at most two holdouts
